title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a Full-Stack Data Engineer to join our Mobile Applications department. This is a hybrid role that combines data engineering with data science overlap, giving you full ownership of the data lifecycle — from ingestion to transformation, analysis, and storytelling.

You will build and optimize scalable pipelines, ingest mobile app data from diverse sources, ensure infrastructure reliability, and deliver insights that directly influence how our apps grow. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics, equally capable of writing production-grade pipelines and uncovering meaningful trends in user behavior.


Key Responsibilities


Data Infrastructure & Pipelines

  • Build and maintain scalable, end-to-end pipelines across cloud environments. Ingest and transform data from files, APIs, mobile telemetry (Firebase, Amplitude, Google Analytics), and external databases into centralized stores.
  • Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Implement data quality monitoring, governance policies, and best practices for privacy, security, and compliance.
  • Participate in technical architecture discussions, contributing expertise on scalable, efficient data systems.


Analytics & Insights

  • Conduct exploratory and advanced analysis using SQL, Python, and statistical methods.
  • Collaborate with Analysts, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Support experimentation and A/B testing by ensuring clean, reliable datasets and analyzing results.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that influence mobile product strategy, user acquisition, and retention.


Collaboration & Best Practices

  • Engage in peer code reviews to uphold high standards of quality and maintainability.
  • Work cross-functionally with software engineering and business teams to ensure data solutions align with company priorities.
  • Document pipelines, workflows, and methodologies to foster reusability and knowledge sharing.


Who You Are


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role focused on data infrastructure and pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency in Python (or a similar programming language such as Java or C#).
  • Experience with AWS (Redshift, RDS, S3) and Google Cloud (BigQuery, Firebase) for managing cloud-based databases and analytics tools.
  • Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, or similar).
  • Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ELT/ETL best practices, and dimensional modeling. Experience with version control systems (e.g., GitHub).
  • Excellent communicator who can bridge technical depth with clear storytelling for non-technical stakeholders.

title: Survey Photogrammetry Processor
description:
O Survey Photogrammetry Processor é essencial para garantir precisão, acurácia, consistência e confiabilidade dos dados de fotogrametria utilizados em decisões estratégicas e geração de insights. A função envolve processamento e análise de dados para projetos de fotogrametria, incluindo preparação, suporte em campo, processamento, controle de qualidade, elaboração de relatórios finais e encerramento de projetos.


Local : Brasil (trabalho remoto),

Principais responsabilidades

  • Processar dados de fotogrametria desde a calibração de cameras até a criação de modelos completos.
  • Realizar controle de qualidade e análise para garantir a integridade dos dados.
  • Preparar relatórios detalhados e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Apoiar metodologias de levantamento e otimização de processos.
  • Atuar com softwares especializados e ferramentas estatísticas.

Requisitos

  • Graduação em área relacionada ou experiência equivalente.
  • Vasta experiência em fotogrametria onshore/offshore.
  • Conhecimento em gestão e análise de dados, mapeamento e softwares específicos.
  • Familiaridade com M365, AutoCAD e processos de fotogrametria.
  • Inglês técnico e capacidade de trabalho remoto.

Desejável

Conhecimento em Agisoft Metashape.

Linguagem de programação como Python, C++ e R.

Habilidade em redação técnica.

title: Software Engineer Sênior
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: Mid/Senior Vue.js Software Engineer
description:
Your next opportunity is on the way!


VILT is an IT company where we value our people, promote teamwork, and of course, good humor.


We believe that diversity and inclusion make our team stronger. Everyone is welcome here, and professionals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

Take a look at this job opportunity and see if you are the next VILTian! (and if you know someone, don’t forget to recommend them)


We’re seeking a Frontend Engineer to help us build intuitive, performant, and modern user experiences with Vue.js and TypeScript . You’ll have the opportunity to work closely with talented engineers and designers, turning ideas into high-quality digital products that impact thousands of users.


What you will do :

  • Develop responsive and elegant web applications using Vue.js and TypeScript.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate APIs and improve data flow.
  • Translate design mockups into reusable and scalable components.
  • Continuously optimize applications for performance and accessibility.
  • Ensure cross-browser compatibility and a great user experience on all devices.
  • Participate in code reviews and actively contribute to the team’s technical growth.


What we expect from you :

Mid-level:

  • Strong experience with Vue.js and its ecosystem (Vuex, Vue Router, etc.).
  • Solid knowledge of TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
  • Experience integrating REST APIs and working with version control (Git).
  • Familiarity with testing frameworks (Playwright).
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).


Senior-level:

  • Proven expertise in Vue.js and TypeScript, delivering complex and scalable frontends.
  • Ability to make architectural decisions and lead UI performance improvements.
  • Strong UX awareness and experience collaborating with design teams.
  • Experience mentoring and supporting junior engineers.
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).


Additional Information:

  • CLT employment type;
  • Working schedule follows the Portugal time zone.


If you’re ready to take your engineering career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Sistemas Fullstack Sênior
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Responsabilidades:

  • Trabalhar na concepção de soluções técnicas, na quebra de tarefas, planejamento e na execução das demandas;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas, fomentando práticas de Code Review e desenvolvimento orientado a testes (TDD/BDD);
  • Manter, monitorar e garantir a eficiência dos serviços construídos e de responsabilidade do seu time;
  • Participar das dinâmicas de trabalho adotadas pelo time;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa no processo de melhoria contínua do seu time;
  • Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura, escalabilidade e segurança dos nossos produtos;
  • Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços;
  • Criar soluções resilientes, escaláveis e de alta performance;
  • Garantir desenvolvimento seguro, observando atualizações de segurança e critérios relevantes;
  • Atuar como referência técnica no time, apoiando colegas menos experientes e disseminando boas práticas.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Compreensão de arquiteturas distribuídas e de alto volume de dados (repositórios, filas, microsserviços, etc);
  • Domínio de conceitos e boas práticas de engenharia de software (da concepção à entrega, sustentação e operação, TDD, documentação, code review, etc);
  • Experiência em Go ou Node.js, com abertura para aprender outras stacks;
  • Experiência com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc);
  • Experiência com infraestrutura em Cloud (preferencialmente GCP);
  • Conhecimentos em APIs Rest, Docker e Kubernetes;
  • Programação concorrente e escalável;
  • Conhecimento em processos de versionamento e práticas de CI/CD;
  • Experiência com observabilidade (monitoramento, logging, tracing, métricas);
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração em equipe;
  • Capacidade de encarar mudanças como oportunidades e aprender com erros;
  • Facilidade em compartilhar conhecimento e atuar como mentor(a);
  • Promover nossa cultura e valores.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento dos conceitos de Big Data, Data Lake, Metadados com perspectiva de governança de dados;
  • Experiência com front-end moderno (Vue.js, Angular, React);
  • Conhecimento de infraestrutura como código (Terraform, Ansible);
  • Conhecimento em serviços de mensageria (PubSub, SNS, Kafka);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de análise e busca (BigQuery, ElasticSearch).


#NeoJourney l Cardápio de Benefícios:

Vale Alimentação/Refeição;

title: Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 5 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You

  • You’re a full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 3+ years of experience.
  • You’re a product-minded engineer with a pragmatic approach to building software.
  • You write expressive readable and maintainable code instead of just hacking together something that only works.
  • You’re curious about IoT, WiFi and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.
  • You want to learn how a business operates and get exposure beyond just writing code.


About the Role

  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Javascript and deploy it via Heroku.
  • Work with the CTO to break down large projects into small shippable slices and execute on those projects.
  • Build API integrations with 3rd party software providers
  • Create intelligent scripts and integrations to automate WiFi management tasks
  • Create and review pull requests in Github.


Why Work at StayFi?

  • You’ll be working directly with the CTO and CEO on mission critical projects.
  • You’ll get mentorship directly from the CTO and senior engineers who can help you go from being a junior or mid-level engineer to being a true master.
  • As you continue to do good work and help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to learn the ins and outs of running a sustainable and growing business.
  • You’ll be working on a small team, so you’ll get the chance to have a large impact within our company and in the vacation rental industry at large.

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Contract Clinical Research Associate
description:
Senior Clinical Research Associate (CRA) — Epilepsy Study (Phase II/III)


I’m currently looking for experienced Senior CRAs to join an exciting Phase II/III Epilepsy Study with one of my key clients. This is a 1.0 FTE contract role supporting 6–8 sites across Brazil — and it’s available for an immediate start .


If you’re someone who thrives in neurology studies and enjoys working on impactful research, this could be a great fit for you.


Here’s what you need to know:

  • Contract: 12 months, with a strong chance of renewal based on performance (my current CRAs with this client have all been extended!)
  • Experience: At least 5+ years of independent monitoring
  • Travel: Regular site visits across Brazil.
  • Therapeutic Area: Neurology , with prior seizure trial experience being strongly desired.


This sponsor truly values quality and consistency, and you’d be joining a talented team dedicated to advancing care for patients with seizure disorders.


The application window is short , so if this sounds like something you’d like to explore, let’s set up a quick chat today!

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About the company:

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


About the opportunity:

We are seeking a motivated DevOps Engineer to support our cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a dynamic environment, leveraging Kubernetes , AWS, GCP, Postgres, and Terraform. In this role, you will participate in automating infrastructure provisioning, managing containerized applications,and maintaining CI/CD workflows to ensure smooth and scalable deployments. You will work closely with senior engineers to troubleshoot issues, implement best practices, and

enhance system reliability and performance across multi-cloud platforms. This is an excellent opportunity to grow your skills in a fast-paced, collaborative DevOps environment.


work MST or PST hours.



What you get to do every day:

-Participate in an on-call rotation on a regular basis and respond to incidents reliably and professionally.

-Maintain and evolve our AWS cloud infrastructure, employing automation, and infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.

-Build and maintain our code pipelines, designing and building automation in order to enable agile software development, using self-service where possible.

-Collaborate efficiently and effectively with other team members and Software Engineers to solve complex problems.

-Quickly absorb context and knowledge while ramping up.


✅Skills/Experience:

Minimum Requirements:

-4-6 years experience in SRE, DevOps, or similar role

-Experience with cloud provider platforms such as AWS or GCP

-Experience with relational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL)

-Familiarity with Kubernetes

- Experience with GitOps CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux,Jenkins)

- Familiarity with declarative infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g.,Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)

-Exposure to logging, monitoring, metrics collection, and observability tools (e.g., DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, CloudWatch)



✨Desired Skills (Nice to Haves):

- Experience with software development and automation in

languages beyond shell scripting (e.g., golang, python, elixir,java, etc.)

- Experience with platform development of tools for development, staging, and integration environments

- Experience with debugging performance or networking issues in applications running on Kubernetes

- Experience with audit compliance (e.g., SOX, SOC2, ISO27001, PCI DSS)

- Working knowledge of UNIX-based Operating Systems

-Computer Science or Engineering degree



Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About the company:

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


About the opportunity:

We are seeking a motivated DevOps Engineer to support our cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a dynamic environment, leveraging Kubernetes , AWS, GCP, Postgres, and Terraform. In this role, you will participate in automating infrastructure provisioning, managing containerized applications,and maintaining CI/CD workflows to ensure smooth and scalable deployments. You will work closely with senior engineers to troubleshoot issues, implement best practices, and

enhance system reliability and performance across multi-cloud platforms. This is an excellent opportunity to grow your skills in a fast-paced, collaborative DevOps environment.


work MST or PST hours.



What you get to do every day:

-Participate in an on-call rotation on a regular basis and respond to incidents reliably and professionally.

-Maintain and evolve our AWS cloud infrastructure, employing automation, and infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.

-Build and maintain our code pipelines, designing and building automation in order to enable agile software development, using self-service where possible.

-Collaborate efficiently and effectively with other team members and Software Engineers to solve complex problems.

-Quickly absorb context and knowledge while ramping up.


✅Skills/Experience:

Minimum Requirements:

-4-6 years experience in SRE, DevOps, or similar role

-Experience with cloud provider platforms such as AWS or GCP

-Experience with relational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL)

-Familiarity with Kubernetes

- Experience with GitOps CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux,Jenkins)

- Familiarity with declarative infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g.,Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)

-Exposure to logging, monitoring, metrics collection, and observability tools (e.g., DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, CloudWatch)



✨Desired Skills (Nice to Haves):

- Experience with software development and automation in

languages beyond shell scripting (e.g., golang, python, elixir,java, etc.)

- Experience with platform development of tools for development, staging, and integration environments

- Experience with debugging performance or networking issues in applications running on Kubernetes

- Experience with audit compliance (e.g., SOX, SOC2, ISO27001, PCI DSS)

- Working knowledge of UNIX-based Operating Systems

-Computer Science or Engineering degree



Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Engenheiro de dados GCP
description:
Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro de Dados com sólida experiência na construção e otimização de pipelines de dados. Este profissional terá papel fundamental no desenho, desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções de integração de dados confiáveis, escaláveis e seguras. O candidato ideal deve ter forte conhecimento em plataformas de nuvem, práticas modernas de engenharia de dados e perfil analítico para garantir o fluxo eficiente de dados na organização.

Responsabilidades Principais

Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines ETL/ELT para ingestão, transformação e entrega de dados estruturados e não estruturados.

Implementar frameworks de ingestão de dados a partir de múltiplas fontes (bancos de dados, APIs, arquivos, streaming etc.).

Garantir qualidade, consistência e confiabilidade dos dados por meio de validação, monitoramento e testes automatizados.

Otimizar fluxos de processamento de dados visando custo e performance.

Colaborar com Cientistas de Dados, Analistas e áreas de negócio para fornecer datasets limpos, confiáveis e bem documentados.

Trabalhar com serviços nativos de nuvem (ex.: BigQuery, Dataproc, Dataflow, Databricks, Snowflake) para implementar arquiteturas escaláveis.

Aplicar boas práticas de CI/CD, versionamento e Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) em pipelines de dados.

Assegurar conformidade com normas de segurança, governança e privacidade (ex.: PII, GDPR, LGPD).

Qualificações Necessárias

Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência comprovada em engenharia de dados, com foco em construção de pipelines.

Domínio em SQL, Python e Spark.

Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (Google Cloud Platform, AWS ou Azure).

Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem de dados, data warehouse e arquiteturas lake/lakehouse.

Vivência com ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, Cloud Composer, Prefect, Dagster).

Familiaridade com práticas de DevOps (Git, pipelines CI/CD, Terraform ou similares).

Diferenciais Desejáveis

Experiência com streaming em tempo real (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Kinesis).

Conhecimentos em containerização (Docker, Kubernetes).

Vivência com pipelines de machine learning e MLOps.

Experiência com catálogos de dados, metadata management e ferramentas de governança.

Competências Comportamentais

Perfil analítico e orientado à resolução de problemas.

Capacidade de comunicar conceitos técnicos complexos de forma clara a públicos não técnicos.

Trabalho em equipe, postura proativa e colaborativa.

Inglês fluente (escrito e falado);

espanhol será considerado um diferencial.

title: Developer
description:
A T-Systems, multinacional alemã pertencente ao Grupo Deutsche Telekom, busca Desenvolvedor (a) Aras Innovator com bom nível de idioma inglês para atuar em projetos ágeis de PLM.

Atuação 100% remota!


Você irá:

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento backend e frontend na plataforma Aras Innovator .
  • Configurar e customizar funcionalidades do Aras conforme necessidades do cliente.
  • Participar de projetos envolvendo Aras Innovator, garantindo aderência a conceitos e processos de PLM.
  • Utilizar práticas ágeis (Scrum/SAFe) em colaboração com times multidisciplinares.
  • Trabalhar com APIs REST e SOAP, integração de sistemas e versionamento de código.


O que buscamos:


  • Experiência em PLM e domínio de Aras Innovator (admin/dev, customização, configuração, projetos com clientes).
  • Conhecimento em REST, SOAP, .Net/C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML/CSS, MS SQL e Git.
  • Vivência em métodos ágeis (Scrum/SAFe).
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Diferenciais: Proficiência em C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, .NET, MySQL, Git, REST API e CSS.


O que oferecemos:

  • Ambiente colaborativo e multicultural.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional em uma das líderes globais em tecnologia.


Se você é apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, colaboração e desafios internacionais, essa é a sua chance de acelerar sua carreira!


Candidate-se agora e venha desenvolver o futuro com a gente!

title: Desenvolvimento Python Pleno AWS - 124355
description:
Sobre a vaga


Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Technical

Strong knowledge of IT Service Management, SAP Basis and SAP Applications

Excellent customer focus / Networking / Relationship Building /Results-driven / Self-organized / Decision making

Understanding of escalation handling and procedures with customers while proactively working with internal teams towards arriving at a resolution

Experience in working with cross-cultural and cross-functional teams or individuals

Proficiency in English (Written and verbal)


Good to have

Cloud architecture and IT technical infrastructure know-how

Knowledge of/certification in one of Azure, AWS or GCP fundamentals

Experience with Migration, Upgrade projects esp. on S/4H Cloud

Knowledge of Project Management Fundamentals, ITIL, Lean Fundamentals is a plus

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

Esta pessoa irá contribuir com os processos de qualidade em tecnologia do Grupo Fleury por meio de técnicas, ferramentas e parceria entre os times de Digital e Tech da empresa. • Habilidade para criar relatórios e documentos simples.

• Experiência básica com pipelines de dados, conseguindo integrar com APIs simples.

title: Web Developer
description:
React Web Developer with strong Strapi expertise | Brazil - remote | Contractor


Job Overview

Our client is seeking a highly skilled React Web Developer with strong Strapi expertise to lead the development, optimization, and continuous improvement of our website and Headless CMS ecosystem. You will be responsible for rebuilding and enhancing the digital front-end experience using React and Strapi v5 , ensuring top-tier performance, stability, and scalability.

This role requires a proactive professional capable of taking ownership from day one—someone who can solve complex problems, implement robust solutions, and drive ongoing improvements across the platform. This is not an entry-level position.


Responsibilities

  • Architect and develop fast, scalable, and reliable front-end solutions using React and Strapi .
  • Rebuild, refine, and optimize existing website sections to maximize performance and conversion.
  • Maintain Core Web Vitals in the green, using real-user monitoring and observability tools.
  • Design, implement, and manage content structures, schemas, and data models in Strapi v5.
  • Integrate CMS features with analytics and marketing tools such as Vercel, Microsoft Clarity, HubSpot APIs, and Google Analytics.
  • Automate deployment workflows and repetitive development tasks to improve efficiency.
  • Collaborate closely with design, content, and product teams to ensure seamless execution.
  • Ensure accurate tracking, strong server response performance, and a high-quality user experience across all devices.
  • Evaluate and responsibly incorporate AI-assisted development tools that enhance productivity without compromising code quality.


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building front-end applications with React .
  • Advanced experience working with Headless CMS platforms , particularly Strapi (v4+; v5 preferred).
  • Proficiency with Vercel , GitHub, continuous deployment, and server-side integrations.
  • Solid understanding of API configuration and consumption within Headless CMS environments.
  • Ability to troubleshoot, debug, and deploy fixes in real-time production environments.
  • Demonstrated experience improving conversion rates and running A/B testing experiments.
  • Strong knowledge of analytics tools and CMS integrations.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.


Bonus Skills

  • Experience integrating and customizing HubSpot APIs .
  • Familiarity with SEO , CRO , and performance-driven digital strategies.
  • Previous experience working in high-growth or startup environments.
  • Exposure to AI-driven development workflows , frameworks, or tools.


If converted to full-time, you will be eligible for:

  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage (effective the 1st of the month following full-time hire)
  • Paid holidays annually
  • Paid vacation and sick leave
  • Flexible working hours

Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.


What are we looking for?

  • 2–3+ years of experience
  • Strong experience with Spring Boot , Microservices , and Cloud
  • Solid hands-on experience with Angular
  • English level B2 or above (mandatory)
  • Experience in implementation projects and recent tech stacks
  • Williness to move to Portugal

  • Health Insurance;
  • Feedback&Coffee – the system that includes Aubay’s Performance Management Cycle, with regular moments of feedback and the Career Progression Model;
  • Working model: hybrid;
  • A Training Academy designed to think of you and your needs. You can count on technical and behavioural training sessions (e-Learning and classroom), Meet&Techs, Webinars and Mentoring;
  • Events and Teambuildings.


What makes us different?

  • Our organizational culture is based on values such as transparency, team spirit, regular feedback and continuous learning;
  • Reference prizes and birthday present;
  • We don’t have a dress code;
  • We know your name and all address each other informally;

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant


Remote – Brazil


*Applications will only be considered with CVs submitted in English.


Company Overview


Sphise is a global outsourcing partner, helping international companies build and manage high-performing teams worldwide.

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Accountant to join their dynamic team.


Position Overview


As a Senior Accountant, you will play a critical role in ensuring financial accuracy and operational excellence across our international finance team. You will take ownership of complex reconciliations, advanced transaction coding, and key components of the month-end close, contributing directly to the integrity of our financial reporting.

Using your analytical mindset, technical expertise, and strong understanding of accounting principles, you will resolve discrepancies, support audits, guide junior staff, and help improve internal processes. Your ability to collaborate across departments, communicate clearly, and manage priorities will be essential as you handle AP/AR escalations, review expenses, and maintain high standards of compliance.

This position offers the opportunity to work in a structured, international environment with clear responsibilities, strong team collaboration, and room for continued professional growth.


Key Responsibilities

  • Transaction Reconciliation: Perform and review complex transaction reconciliations in QuickBooks Online; identify and resolve discrepancies independently.
  • Advanced Transaction Coding: Accurately classify and code complex transactions, including accruals, prepaids, and multi-department allocations in compliance with accounting standards.
  • Financial Reporting Support: Assist in preparing monthly financial statements and supporting schedules; contribute to month-end close processes.
  • Expense Management: Review and approve expense reports for accuracy and policy compliance; provide guidance to staff on expense procedures.
  • Accounts Payable/Receivable: Handle escalated AP/AR issues, manage aging reports, assist with collection efforts, and maintain vendor relationships.
  • Journal Entry Preparation: Prepare and post standard and adjusting journal entries; maintain supporting documentation.
  • Process Improvement: Recommend improvements to accounting procedures and help implement best practices for efficiency.
  • Audit Support: Prepare requested audit documentation and schedules; serve as a key contact for auditor inquiries.
  • Junior Staff Support: Provide guidance and answer questions from junior accounting team members as needed.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO) and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Solid understanding of GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Excellent attention to detail with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks effectively.
  • Strong communication skills for working with various departments and external contacts.


Preferred Experience

  • 4-6 years of progressive accounting experience.
  • Experience with month-end close processes and financial reporting.
  • Background in small-to-mid-sized business accounting environments.
  • Familiarity with expense management tools and multiple accounting software platforms.
  • Experience training or mentoring junior staff members.
  • Strong English Skills.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Supervisor de Lazer
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Supervisionar, treinar e motivar os agentes de viagens;
  • Acompanhar o desempenho individual e coletivo da equipe;
  • Promover um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e orientado para resultados.
  • Garantir um atendimento de excelência aos clientes, presencialmente, por telefone ou online;
  • Resolver conflitos, reclamações e situações complexas de atendimento;
  • Manter um padrão de qualidade nos serviços prestados pela equipe.
  • Supervisionar a montagem de pacotes turísticos, nacionais e internacionais;
  • Apoiar na negociação com fornecedores (companhias aéreas, hotéis, operadoras, etc.);
  • Garantir que as ofertas estejam atualizadas, competitivas e dentro das políticas da empresa.
  • Acompanhar reservas, emissões, alterações e cancelamentos de serviços;
  • Monitorar prazos, documentos e pagamentos junto aos fornecedores;
  • Garantir que todos os processos estejam em conformidade com as normas legais e políticas internas.
  • Colaborar com o setor comercial para alcançar metas de vendas;
  • Sugerir campanhas, promoções e ações para captação e fidelização de clientes;
  • Analisar relatórios de desempenho e propor melhorias.
  • Monitorar metas, produtividade e qualidade do atendimento;
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e apresentar resultados à direção.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre destinos, tendências do mercado e novidades do setor;
  • Incentivar a equipe a participar de treinamentos, workshops e famtours.
  • Mais as atribuições de vendas, pois o supervisor também vende


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Conhecimento dos destinos de viagem, geografia.
  • Conhecimento em informática.
  • Ensino médio completo, desejável ensino superior em turismo.
  • Experiência em agência de viagens multimarcas.

title: Security & Low-Voltage Designer / Estimator (Remote – UTS Group)
description:
Are you a detail-driven professional with experience in security and low-voltage system design and estimating? UTS Group is expanding our technical team and we want to hear from you.


UTS Group is a leading North American security integration company serving clients across Canada and the U.S. We specialize in Access Control, CCTV, Intercom, Door Hardware, Automatic Doors, and full low-voltage infrastructure. We are looking for a Security & Low-Voltage Designer / Estimator who can review drawings, analyze tenders, design system layouts, and prepare accurate cost estimates for complex projects.


This is a remote, full-time role, working Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time (ET).

⸻

Position Overview

This hybrid role blends design and estimating. You will review construction drawings, bids, and tender packages, then translate them into complete design documents, material takeoffs, and competitive estimates. You’ll prepare layouts, risers, and technical specifications using AutoCAD and Bluebeam, while collaborating with project managers, sales teams, and vendors to ensure accuracy and compliance.

⸻

Key Responsibilities

• Review and interpret technical drawings, floor plans, door schedules, and tender documents

title: Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager
description:
MatchPoint Solutions is a fast-growing, young, energetic global IT-Engineering services company with clients across the US. We provide technology solutions to various clients like Uber, Robinhood, Netflix, Airbnb, Google, Sephora, and more! More recently, we have expanded to working internationally in Canada, China, Ireland, UK, Brazil, and India. Through our culture of innovation, we inspire, build, and deliver business results, from idea to outcome. We keep our clients on the cutting edge of the latest technologies and provide solutions by using industry-specific best practices and expertise.


We are excited to be continuously expanding our team. If you are interested in this position, please send over your updated resume. We look forward to hearing from you!


This is a large impact role that demands someone who can excel in a fast paced and ever changing environment.


Title: Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager

Location: Brazil, remote

Work Time Zone: PST overlap

Start Date: Immediate


The Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager is a strategic role responsible for the planning, execution, and operational success of the organization's IT Infrastructure initiatives and daily operations. This individual will manage a portfolio of complex, cross-functional programs, ensuring they align with strategic business objectives and are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget. The role requires a strong blend of technical expertise, program management skills, and leadership capabilities to manage both projects and ongoing operational stability. This position is part of the IT Global Infrastructure & Operation team and will be remote.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Program and Project Management: Lead the end-to-end management of multiple, interconnected infrastructure projects (e.g., data center migrations, cloud platform adoption, EUC, IAM, network upgrades, etc) from initiation to closure.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop and implement strategic plans and roadmaps for the IT infrastructure and operations function, ensuring alignment with overall business goals and future needs.
  • Budget and Financial Management: Develop, monitor, and control program and operational budgets, manage expenditures, and ensure cost-effectiveness of IT investments.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks and issues impacting program implementation or daily operations, develop comprehensive mitigation strategies, and manage issue resolution processes.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders across various departments, providing regular updates on project status, performance metrics, and risks.
  • Process Improvement and Compliance: Drive the adoption of industry best practices (e.g., ITIL, Agile, Waterfall) and ensure compliance with relevant security protocols and regulatory requirements.


The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in program or project management within an IT infrastructure environment, with a proven track record of successfully managing large-scale, complex initiatives.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of infrastructure technologies including cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP), networking, servers (Windows/Linux), virtualization, and data center operations.
  • Project Management Methodologies: Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project) and methodologies (Agile, Waterfall). PMP or PgMP certification is highly desirable.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication (written and oral), and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with keen attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Strategic thinking and the capacity to influence stakeholders at all levels.


Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • 5%-10% travel as per business requirements.


It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Experience in managing geographically dispersed or matrixed teams.
  • Jira, Confluence

title: Full Stack Engineer (Remote, $110K USD)
description:
Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer

100% Remote | Must have at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST)


About Ascen

Ascen (ascen.com) is a back-office platform built exclusively for staffing companies. We empower staffing firms to focus on their clients and candidates by providing a robust suite of back-office services—including contractor onboarding, timesheets, payroll, invoicing, funding, and employer of record—within a sleek, white-label, all-in-one platform.


We’re profitable, experiencing rapid growth (ranked number 78 on the Inc. 5000 as one of the fastest-growing companies in the US), and backed by a publicly traded company. Now, we’re seeking an experienced Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our remote team and help drive our next phase of innovation.


Role Overview

In this role, you will be a crucial contributor to our platform, designing and implementing features across the tech stack, optimizing performance, and ensuring the highest security standards. You’ll have a chance to build impactful solutions that streamline staffing operations for our clients.


Ideal Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Python.
  • 5+ years of experience building web applications (FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
  • 2+ years of experience with JavaScript frameworks (React or Vue).
  • Comfortable independently developing full-stack features, from backend to frontend.
  • Extensive knowledge of cybersecurity best practices.
  • Experience with payments or fintech is preferred.
  • Must be able to work with at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST) .


Interview Process

  • Introductory Call – 15-30 minutes
  • Meet with a member of our team for a brief conversation about your background and the role.
  • Technical Deep Dive – 45-60 minutes
  • Walk us through a feature or project you’ve built, focusing on code review, design decisions, improvements, and lessons learned. This is an opportunity to showcase your technical expertise and problem-solving approach.

title: Desenvolvedor Júnior (Microsoft Power Platform)
description:
Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Ensino superior completo nas áreas de tecnologia, desenvolvimento ou afins;
  • Inglês Básico.


Habilidades Técnicas

  • Power BI, Power Automate e Power App;
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de software Web e banco de dados;
  • Experiência em SQL e Análise de Dados;
  • Habilidades em Python, JavaScript, React, html5, CSS3, construção de API e microserviços;
  • Experiência em levantar e documentar requisitos juntos aos usuários;
  • Programação de testes unitários e de integração;
  • Capacidade de desenvolvimento de soluções utilizando Power BI / Power Platform, bem como as linguagens suportadas na plataforma ArcGIS .


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Modelagem de dados e estatística.
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimentos na plataforma ArcGIS.
  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios.


Responsabilidades:

  • Colaborar com as áreas de negócio na identificação dos requisitos, design e implantação da solução;
  • Criar fluxos automatizados entre aplicações e serviços utilizando o Microsoft Power Platform: Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate e Power Pages;
  • Desenvolver e manter Dashboards no Microsoft Power BI;
  • Escrever códigos de desenvolvimento dos sistemas seguindo padrões de nomenclatura e práticas da empresa;
  • Detalhar projetos, determinando suas interfaces, limites de automação e plataforma tecnológica;
  • Construir modelos funcionais e de dados de sistemas, aplicando boas práticas que garantam visão estruturada, qualidade, reutilização, facilidade de manutenção de códigos;
  • Identificar, avaliar e definir frameworks, componentes e softwares para desenvolvimento, através da conceituação, documentação e experimentação, buscando aprimorar as soluções desenvolvidas;
  • Realizar avaliações de segurança e performance de soluções;
  • Aplicar e avaliar testes funcionais e não funcionais, seguindo o plano de testes estabelecido, junto ao cliente visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente;
  • Escrever o plano de testes funcionais e não funcionais visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente;
  • Avaliar e elaborar a documentação de usuário e administração de sistemas desenvolvidos e os repositórios de informação dos projetos;
  • Assegurar as interfaces de integração com outras plataformas/soluções.


Por que escolher a Geosistemas?


Saúde e Bem-Estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico - Sul América.
  • ✅ Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais.
  • ️ ♂️ Acesso ao Gympass para cuidar do corpo e da mente.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack ( Flutter com .Net)
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Principais responsabilidades:

Responsabilidades:

• Desenvolver e manter aplicações robustas e escaláveis usando .NET Framework e .NET Core e aplicativos nativos em Flutter.

• Participar em todas as fases do ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software, incluindo análise, design, implementação e manutenção.

• Garantir a conformidade dos designs de software com as especificações técnicas e requisitos de negócios.

• Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para identificar e resolver problemas complexos de software.

• Conduzir revisões de código e Garantia de qualidade do código com TDD e testes unitários.

• Participar da elaboração de propostas de solução técnica e estimativa de desenvolvimento para elaboração de propostas comerciais.

• Integrar APIs e uso do Firebase para monitoramento e análise de dados.

• Colaborar com equipes ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) com designers e gerentes de produto

• Gerenciar repositórios e versionamento com Git e GitHub/GitLab.

• Documentar de processos e comunicação de progresso para stakeholders.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

- ANDROID

- FLUTTER

- Android SDK

- Android Studio

- iOS Design

- iOS development

- Desenvolvimento para iOS

- Android Architecture Components

- Desenvolvimento de Aplicativos Android

- Java Android

- Arquitetura DevOps e Sustentação de Sistemas

- .NET Framework, SQL Server, MVC, DDD, Unit Tests, API REST, Azure Devops, Azure Cloud.

- .NET (FRAMEWORK E CORE)

- ADVANCED TROUBLESHOOTING


Formato de trabalho: Home office


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Mission

  • Responsible for building, managing, and optimizing data pipelines;
  • Support for defining data flows and access to data sources;
  • Ensure compliance with data governance, data architecture, and data security requirements.


Responsibilities

  • Create, maintain, and optimize data pipelines for data structures that encompass data modeling, data transformation, schemas, metadata, and workload management;
  • Drive Automation through effective metadata management;
  • Participate in ensuring compliance and governance during data use, including the maintenance of the data catalog;
  • Collaborate and support data owners and other stakeholders around data topics;
  • Ensure the proper use of the data architecture defined by Data Factory team;
  • Respect and follow security principles ensuring compliance with data delivery.

  • Strong experience with various Data Management architectures, mainly AWS environment;
  • Strong experience with Data Modeling;
  • Ability to design, build and manage data pipelines;

  • Solid knowledge in: Databrics, Spark, python, terraform, SQL, Scala, S3, AWS Glue, AWS Athena, AWS Lambda, AWS Step Functions; Big data, Relational Databases;
  • Experience in: EMR, Gitflow, Agile Metodology; DevOps.


Languages

  • English: Advanced or Fluent


Additional information

  • Remote work

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce Pleno
description:
Desenvolvedor Salesforce Pleno

Requisitos Obrigatórios

- Experiência com desenvolvimento em Salesforce, com proficiência na criação de classes Apex, triggers, tratamento de exceções e testes unitários

- É necessário ter experiência com Lightning Web Components (LWC) ou Aura, além de conhecimento em integrações via API REST/SOAP

- Familiaridade com o uso de Apex assíncrono, incluindo Batch, Queueable e Future, é essencial

- É importante ter experiência no uso de Git para versionamento de código e conhecimentos no ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento e deployments, como change sets ou CI/CD

- Deverá ter habilidades em ferramentas declarativas, incluindo Flow, criação de objetos, campos, tipos de registro e layouts de página.

- Inglês intermediário para leitura e escrita é requerido.

Requisitos Desejáveis

- Certificação Salesforce Platform Developer I é um diferencial, assim como experiência com integração de modelos de Inteligência Artificial via API

- Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis e capacidade de trabalhar de maneira colaborativa com outros times para entender requisitos e propor soluções escaláveis são desejáveis

- Habilidade em resolver problemas complexos e perfil autodidata com iniciativa para aprender por conta própria serão valorizados.

Resumo dos requisitos: Apex, LWC, Aura, API REST/SOAP, Apex assíncrono, Git, CI/CD, Salesforce Platform Developer I.

Disponibilidade de início: Imediata

title: Full Stack Mobile Developer
description:
About the Role  

I am supporting a US healthcare client in hiring a Full-Stack Mobile Developer to take end-to-end ownership of their flagship mobile application. In this role, you will serve as the sole mobile developer , responsible for evolving an app that pairs with a Bluetooth-enabled pulse oximeter ring to capture overnight sleep data and securely upload it to the cloud.


You won’t be working in isolation—while you’ll lead all mobile-focused design and development, you’ll collaborate closely with a team of experienced C#/.NET backend engineers. You’ll also contribute to backend features related to sleep-study processing and data workflows, helping shape the overall product experience from device integration through clinical-grade data analysis.


This is an opportunity to own a critical mobile product in a modern health-tech environment, working with senior engineers to deliver technology that directly impacts patient outcomes. The ideal candidate will have expertise in both mobile development (Flutter/Dart) and backend technologies (C#/.NET), and be capable of ensuring seamless device integration, reliable overnight data collection, and robust backend connectivity with Azure services. 

Key Responsibilities  


  • Lead the development and maintenance of cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter/Dart for iOS and Android. 
  • Implement and optimize Bluetooth connectivity with the ring pulse oximeter device. 
  • Address Android battery optimization challenges to guarantee reliable overnight data collection. 
  • Manage the release process for both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. 
  • Collaborate with backend developers on Azure-hosted .NET services, contributing to backend development when required. 
  • Ensure compliance with health data security and privacy standards. 
  • Work independently while providing technical leadership within the team. 


Requirements  


  • Professional level English comprehension (spoken, reading/writing)
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in mobile development. 
  • Proven experience with Flutter/Dart  for cross-platform mobile applications. 
  • Working knowledge of C# and .NET , with the ability to contribute to backend services. 
  • Deep understanding of Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE)  implementation. 
  • Experience with Android battery optimization techniques  for background processes. 
  • Successful track record of publishing and maintaining apps in the App Store and Google Play. 
  • Experience integrating with Microsoft Azure services . 
  • Familiarity with Firebase  (Authentication, Crashlytics, Analytics), Sentry , and PostHog . 
  • Advanced English communication skills (C1 level ), both written and spoken. 
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail. 
  • Prior experience in health or medical app development is a plus. 

Technical Skills  


  • Primary:  Flutter/Dart, Bluetooth LE, iOS, Android 
  • Secondary:  C#, .NET, Azure, Firebase 
  • Tools:  GitHub, Sentry, PostHog, App Store Connect, Google Play Console 


What We Offer  


  • The opportunity to develop innovative health technology with real impact. 
  • Competitive salary based on experience. 
  • Professional growth and development opportunities. 
  • A collaborative team culture that values independence and initiative.

You won’t be working in isolation—while you’ll lead all mobile-focused design and development, you’ll collaborate closely with a team of experienced C#/.NET backend engineers. You’ll also contribute to backend features related to sleep-study processing and data workflows, helping shape the overall product experience from device integration through clinical-grade data analysis.


This is an opportunity to own a critical mobile product in a modern health-tech environment, working with senior engineers to deliver technology that directly impacts patient outcomes. The ideal candidate will have expertise in both mobile development (Flutter/Dart) and backend technologies (C#/.NET), and be capable of ensuring seamless device integration, reliable overnight data collection, and robust backend connectivity with Azure services. 

Key Responsibilities  


  • Lead the development and maintenance of cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter/Dart for iOS and Android. 
  • Implement and optimize Bluetooth connectivity with the ring pulse oximeter device. 
  • Address Android battery optimization challenges to guarantee reliable overnight data collection. 
  • Manage the release process for both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. 
  • Collaborate with backend developers on Azure-hosted .NET services, contributing to backend development when required. 
  • Ensure compliance with health data security and privacy standards. 
  • Work independently while providing technical leadership within the team. 


Requirements  


  • Professional level English comprehension (spoken, reading/writing)
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in mobile development. 
  • Proven experience with Flutter/Dart  for cross-platform mobile applications. 
  • Working knowledge of C# and .NET , with the ability to contribute to backend services. 
  • Deep understanding of Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE)  implementation. 
  • Experience with Android battery optimization techniques  for background processes. 
  • Successful track record of publishing and maintaining apps in the App Store and Google Play. 
  • Experience integrating with Microsoft Azure services . 
  • Familiarity with Firebase  (Authentication, Crashlytics, Analytics), Sentry , and PostHog . 
  • Advanced English communication skills (C1 level ), both written and spoken. 
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail. 
  • Prior experience in health or medical app development is a plus. 

Technical Skills  


  • Primary:  Flutter/Dart, Bluetooth LE, iOS, Android 
  • Secondary:  C#, .NET, Azure, Firebase 
  • Tools:  GitHub, Sentry, PostHog, App Store Connect, Google Play Console 


What We Offer  


  • The opportunity to develop innovative health technology with real impact. 
  • Competitive salary based on experience. 
  • Professional growth and development opportunities. 
  • A collaborative team culture that values independence and initiative.
